_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. model sheet of a small wiry-haired terrier-and-border-collie mix with three legs, the left hind leg ending cleanly below the hock, one ear pinned back and one upright, steel-wool coat, gray whiskers; standing like a tripod with chest out, mid-scuttle with motion lines, asleep across a man's ankles holding a wooden pen holder, standing inside a cardboard produce box; puppy and adult heads; labeled BARNABY II 2014–. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
